title: SKUAST-K inaugurates 12 facilities at Shuhama to boost sheep, goat research

ai.summary: SKUAST-K inaugurated 12 new facilities at Shuhama to boost sheep and goat research in Kashmir, with the Vice-Chancellor emphasizing their role in improving livestock productivity and farmer livelihoods.

facts.quote: The Mountain Research Centre for Sheep and Goat (MRCS&G) of Sher-e-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences and Technology of Kashmir (SKUAST-K) on Monday inaugurated 12 major facilities aimed at strengthening research, livestock management, animal welfare and farmer-oriented services.

facts.claim: Facilities include a Farm Research Laboratory, Farm Dispensary, Model Dairy Goat Unit, Total Mixed Ration (TMR) Facility, Manure Composting Facility, Farm Workshop-cum-Garage, eight renovated Experimental Animal Sheds, upgraded Training-cum-Skill Hall, Smart Sheep Shed, Solar-Based Borewell Irrigation Facility, Sub-Alpine Pasture and Livestock Quarantine Facility
facts.quote: The facilities include a Farm Research Laboratory, Farm Dispensary, Model Dairy Goat Unit, Total Mixed Ration (TMR) Facility, Manure Composting Facility, Farm Workshop-cum-Garage, eight renovated Experimental Animal Sheds, upgraded Training-cum-Skill Hall, Smart Sheep Shed, Solar-Based Borewell Irrigation Facility, Sub-Alpine Pasture and Livestock Quarantine Facility.

facts.claim: The facilities were created or upgraded during 2025–26
facts.quote: The facilities, created or upgraded during 2025–26, were inaugurated by SKUAST-K Vice-Chancellor Prof. Nazir Ahmad Ganai at the Centre’s Shuhama campus.

facts.claim: Vice-Chancellor Prof. Nazir Ahmad Ganai inaugurated the facilities
facts.quote: The facilities, created or upgraded during 2025–26, were inaugurated by SKUAST-K Vice-Chancellor Prof. Nazir Ahmad Ganai at the Centre’s Shuhama campus.

facts.claim: The inauguration was attended by Director Planning Prof. Rohitash Kumar, Dean, Faculty of Veterinary Sciences and Animal Husbandry, Prof. Riaz Ahmad Shah, Registrar Prof. Azmat Alam Khan and Estates Officer Er. Idres-ul-Rahman
facts.quote: The inauguration ceremony was attended by Director Planning Prof. Rohitash Kumar, Dean, Faculty of Veterinary Sciences and Animal Husbandry, Prof. Riaz Ahmad Shah, Registrar Prof. Azmat Alam Khan and Estates Officer Er. Idres-ul-Rahman, besides scientists, faculty members and officials.

facts.claim: Vice-Chancellor emphasized the need to make optimum use of facilities for capacity building and hands-on training of sheep and goat breeders
facts.quote: Prof. Ganai particularly emphasised the need to make optimum use of the newly established facilities for capacity building and hands-on training of sheep and goat breeders.

facts.claim: The Centre aims to improve livestock productivity and farmer livelihoods
facts.quote: He said scientific technologies and improved livestock management practices must reach farmers to enhance productivity and improve their livelihoods.
